versions.changelog: Fix duplicate daily summary blocks, prevent concurrent note-write races with file locking, and switch the skill to prefer the official Obsidian CLI with filesystem fallback only when needed.
feat: organize daily/weekly notes by year/month subfolders (daily/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md)
Nested directory paths (YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md) for daily and weekly notes, with fallback to legacy flat paths for backwards compatibility
Initial release: daily summary, weekly report, session append-entry, tags, config.json support
